notes: The executables ship prebuilt. Settings, saves and ROM path caches use GENESIS_USER_DIR when set, then the writable launcher directory, then %LOCALAPPDATA%/DynaBroCollection. The selected profile keeps the latest five logs per executable in its logs folder.
